area: test performance and a circularity in cycle 172's own guard

find.report_claim: PRINCIPLE-010 caps a unit test at 50ms and cycle 172 added tests/test_rebuild_isolation.py to protect build_scene
find.live_evidence: that suite was 54 tests taking 43s (0.8s per test) because each of 50 parametrized cases performed a full scene build; the project suite grew from 60s to 464-704s under the same machine, making the test gate the slowest thing in the loop
find.consumer_evidence: slower feedback means the gate gets skipped; and worse, the parametrized design hid a circularity -- the checklist of attributes was discovered from the very file being tested, so deleting a build_scene assignment removed it from its own checklist (50 -> 49) and the test still passed

read: shooter/game.py:658 (_pickup_spot) and :402 (particles), the only attributes initialised solely in build_scene
the gate timing history: 60s before, 464-840s while the parametrized suite ran
killed: keeping 50 parametrized cases for a per-attribute failure message: one build plus one dirty pass plus one rebuild tests the identical property, and 43s of suite time is a real cost every gate pays
pinning the attribute list as a literal: it would drift from build_scene exactly like the stale contract pins did in cycle 138
treating the surviving mutation as a coverage gap in build_scene: the gap was in the test's own design, not in the code
analyze.survivor: collapse the 50 cases into one build/dirty/rebuild pass, and derive the expected attribute set from the COMMITTED file at HEAD so a deleted assignment cannot vanish from its own checklist

fix.shooter: tests/test_rebuild_isolation.py drops from 54 tests to 6: the attribute sweep now sets a sentinel on the whole surface and rebuilds once, and a new test_no_committed_scene_attribute_has_been_dropped compares build_scene's working attribute set against the one at HEAD from git, failing by name when an assignment is removed; the connectivity caveat (reassignment, not correct values) stays documented in the test

shooter.speed: tests/test_rebuild_isolation.py 43s -> 1.2-2.0s; full suite 704s -> 121s; the gate's test phase 464s -> 118s
shooter.tests: 637 passed, 2 xfailed (685 -> 637 is the consolidation: 54 tests folded into 6)
shooter.circularity_proved: with the _pickup_spot assignment deleted, the discovered checklist shrank from 50 to 49 attributes and the old test passed; after comparing against HEAD the same deletion fails with "build_scene no longer sets ['_pickup_spot'], which it set at HEAD"
shooter.restore: shooter/game.py was byte-identical (sha256) after every mutation
shooter.drift: keystone's editor schema advanced 65 -> 66 (rename_camera_path, duplicate_camera_path) in commit fc6734e; the pin and the named-action list were updated from the actual schema.py diff rather than guessed
